settings.query_notes: Only .doc(<fixedId>).get() is used (221 call sites, no where/orderBy/limit/onSnapshot). placeHolderImage alone has 52 call sites, globalSettings 18, DriverNearBy 13, razorpaySettings 13. Server side: FirestoreHelper::getDocument('settings/maintenance_settings') in FirebaseMaintenance middleware.
settings.writes: Only one client write: layouts/nav.blade.php:196 `database.collection('settings').doc('Version').set({})` when the Version doc is missing (creates an empty doc). Otherwise read-only from web; data comes from the admin panel.
settings.access: mixed: public-read for presentation docs (globalSettings, placeHolderImage, DriverNearBy, VendorNearBy, DeliveryCharge, vendor, Version, specialDiscountOffer, story, languages, homepageTemplate, footerTemplate, privacyPolicy, termsAndConditions, ContactUs, maintenance_settings, CODSettings, walletSettings, googleMapKey.key). Payment-gateway docs must be SPLIT: public flags/publishable keys (isEnabled/isEnable/enable, isSandbox*, isLive, razorpayKey, stripeKey/clientpublishableKey, paypalClient/paypalAppId, publicKey, PublicKey, merchant_id, image, *_url) may be exposed; secrets must be server-only (razorpaySecret, stripeSecret, paypalSecret, payStack.secretKey, flutterWave.secretKey/encryptionKey, merchant_key, MercadoPago.AccessToken, xendit apiKey, midtrans serverKey, orange auth/clientSecret/merchantKey). notification_setting must be server-only. Version write should be removed or admin-only.
settings.notes: SECURITY: (1) Every checkout page (checkout, gift_card/giftcard, parcel_checkout, rental_checkout, rental_orders_detail, ondemand_checkout, pay_extra_charge, pay_service_charge, transactions/index) reads ALL gateway SECRET keys into hidden inputs and POSTs them back to the PHP controllers (e.g. checkout.blade.php:984-1260, then 1764 razorpayKey, 2312 paystack_secret_key, 2422 flutterWave_secret_key, 2548 xendit_apiKey, 2654 midtrans_serverKey, 2772 orangepay_merchantKey) - secrets are world-readable today. In MySQL these must be read server-side only and the controllers must stop trusting posted keys. (2) notification_setting.serviceJson is a Firebase service-account credential readable by every visitor (footer.blade.php:2082) and re-posted to route storeServiceFile. (3) DeliveryCharge values are copied into cookie 'deliveryChargemain' (products/detail.blade.php:309) and CheckoutController/ProductController compute delivery fees from that client cookie. OTHER: enable-flag naming is inconsistent per gateway (isEnabled vs isEnable vs enable); sandbox flag is isSandboxEnabled (razorpay/stripe/MercadoPago) vs isSandbox (others) vs isLive (paypal, inverted). Stripe key read as stripeKey in 8 files but clientpublishableKey in transactions/index; paypal client as paypalClient in 8 files but paypalAppId in giftcard - store both or normalize. Typos relied on: driverRadios, radios, MercadoPago PublicKey/AccessToken, ContactUs.Address. Suggest table `settings(doc_id PK, data JSON)` or one column per field per doc; keep doc ids exactly.

sections.notes: BUG: parcel_checkout.blade.php:704-712 and rental_checkout.blade.php:291-299 test `AdminCommissionRes.enable` at TOP level (not adminCommision.enable) - field likely never exists, so commission becomes 0 for those flows; don't add a top-level enable column unless admin writes it. Commission type casing inconsistent ('fixed' vs 'Fixed'). Commission is computed client-side and sent to server via hidden inputs (#adminCommission) - security: recompute server-side.

country.shape: country name, matched against cityToCountry[timezone city]

tax.shape: numeric (likely stored as string by admin; parseFloat on use)

tax.query_notes: 11 call sites, all where(country==).where(enable==true).where(sectionId==) except gift_card/giftcard.blade.php:557 which omits sectionId. Composite index (country, enable, sectionId).
tax.notes: Rows are copied into order docs as taxSetting [{country,enable,id,tax,title,type}] client-side - tax amount is client-computed (security: recompute server-side). Gift-card tax rows may have no sectionId.

area.shape: array<GeoPoint> polygon vertices, each read as {latitude: float, longitude: float}

zone.query_notes: layouts/footer.blade.php:2105 getUserZoneId(): fetches ALL published zones and runs point-in-polygon in JS; result user_zone_id is matched against vendors.zoneId.
zone.notes: Not GeoFirestore, but geo data: area is a GeoPoint array. In MySQL store as JSON [[lat,lng],...] or a POLYGON column (then ST_Contains server-side). Admin likely also has a name field (not read by web).
